sources.quote: 7.2 Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: The meeting premise is wrong. Aurelia's manual in force is revision 4, which replaces revision 3. Under 7.1 a change of coating or surface treatment needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipping. Notification alone is not enough. Revision 4 also requires notification at least 90 days before implementation. The switch of BK-330 to zinc flake therefore cannot ship on notification only. Nothing in the documents already covers this change. The documents don't link BK-330 to a program or customer. I took Aurelia as the customer from the proposal text.
